name: Falcon 9 first stage B1019
about: Flight 20's booster: boost-back, entry and landing burns, then down on Landing Zone 1. It never flew again.

pieces.why: MECO at T+2:23, 75 km, 1.67 km/s; boost-back from T+3:47, entry burn T+8:01 for 20 s, landing burn T+9:11 for 33 s. Delta-v of the three burns is not published; RS5's ascent and return physics flies them
Landing Zone 1 (formerly LC-13), position from memory; touchdown T+9:44

events.why: first landing of an orbital booster, 20:38 EST on 21 Dec
